label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Fuego continuo arderá sobre el altar; no se apagará.
spanish: Fuego continuamente se hará arder sobre el altar; no se apagará.
grammarChanges: Changed active 'arderá' to the passive causative 'se hará arder' to preserve the hophal stem force (be caused to burn) instead of an active qal-like reading.

Moved tamid from the adjective 'continuo' modifying 'fuego' to the adverb 'continuamente' modifying the verb, matching its function as an absolute noun used adverbially rather than as an attribute of the fire.
readerNote: Chose the passive causative 'se hará arder' for the hophal stem and the adverb 'continuamente' (rather than an adjective on fuego) for tamid; both are grammatical choices, not changes to participants or sense.
